messages:
elaine-sales: NimbusPay asked about switching from RivalAI to Redwood. Main asks: POC scope, how token billing compares, function-call compatibility, streaming behavior, and short-term static IPs for their staging environment. Can we scope what the POC needs?

omar-se: From presales: they will send a sample bundle (~150 prompts), a couple of function schemas, and their client expects identical framing for streamed deltas so their frontend doesn't need rewrites. Also need a quick note on expected token variance.

tess-eng: We should build a tiny compatibility proxy for the POC. Tasks: param mapping (RivalAI->Redwood), stream reformatter, and optional small output normalizer for stop sequences. Example mapping we can do in proxy: RivalAI POST /v2/converse -> /v1/chat.generate, map roles, map function call envelopes.

omar-se: Important: prepare a token-delta report (3 prompt types: quick reply, multi-turn convo, and long instruction). Customer will evaluate billing impact. Recommend include both token counts and estimated cost delta.

raj-security: Security intake: they want BYOK, per-customer log retention 30d, and static egress IPs for staging. Hosted can do BYOK on enterprise; retention shorter than default requires Dedicated/enterprise config. For IPs we can allocate temporary addresses for a POC but need ops to confirm rotation plan.

violet-legal: We can include a POC addendum for any temporary network commitments and a capped credit for billing deltas during the trial. Will need finance to OK the cap. Also confirm data residency requirement (they mentioned EU-only processing).

sam-ops: infra-bot: staging-nimbus-3210 created. I can hold 2 static egress IPs for a 14-day POC window. Need an emergency contact and start/end dates. We can also provision an S3 export hook for request logs; advise customer to provide bucket ARN.

tess-eng: On streaming parity: RivalAI sends chunked JSON frames with fields {part, meta}. We stream SSE. For the POC we'll wrap our SSE into RivalAI-like chunk frames and keep event ordering identical. That should make their client see no behavioral change.

omar-se: Also surface differences in model families and quantization. If they used RivalAI's optimized-small model, we should pick Redwood's closest family and note possible semantics changes. We'll include recommended prompt adjustments to minimize drift.

elain-sales: Timeline: POC kickoff in 7 business days. Can Eng/SE deliver shim + token-delta by 48 hours before kickoff?

tess-eng: Yes, we can ship a prototype shim and a 30-sample delta report 48h pre-kickoff. We'll need their sample bundle by EOD Wed.

raj-security: Flag: they requested the ability to rotate KMS keys during the POC. Hosted BYOK can support key rotation but need coordination for token encryption and audit. I'll prepare the steps.

violet-legal: I'll draft the POC addendum (IP lease + billing credit clause) and share with finance.

sam-ops: I'll reserve IPs and create a temp S3 export plan. Send me start/end & contact.

elain-sales: Summary actions: - Omar: request sample prompts + function schema - Tess: build proxy shim + token-delta report - Raj: BYOK rotation steps + SOC2 docs - Violet: POC addendum + pricing credit language - Sam: reserve IPs + S3 export setup

elain-sales: Who can join the kickoff call (Tue 10am CET)? @tess-eng @omar-se @raj-security @violet-legal

tess-eng: I'll join.

omar-se: same.

raj-security: I'll attend first 15 minutes.

infra-bot: credentials for staging-nimbus-3210 delivered to elaine-sales 1:1.

elain-sales: Great, I'll nudge the customer for the prompt pack and confirm EU region requirement. Thanks team.
